scope: Priority collection attempts under plan section 6.4. Supplemental immutable research evidence only; does not replace canonical facts, legislative rows, or existing coverage conflicts.
timestampPolicy: Web-reader attempts expose no per-request clock: retrievedAt uses observed UTC calendar date (day precision). Direct-fetch response hashes include exact observed UTC timestamps. No synthetic midnight timestamps.
rightsAndRetention: No bulk mirroring, authentication bypass, certificate override or restricted/private records collected. Public municipal attachments downloaded transiently for checksum/text extraction; PDFs and rendered page removed. Retain bounded attributed excerpts, hashes and source URLs only; unknown reuse licenses are not permission to redistribute entire documents.

observationContract.findings: Optional bounded sourceOriginalText excerpts with SHA-256 of exact UTF-8 excerpt text; page is a 1-based PDF page where established. responseSha256, when present, separately hashes exact fetched response bytes.
observationContract.httpStatus: null means reader did not expose HTTP status, not HTTP 200. Availability describes observed retrieval, not completeness.
observationContract.metadataSeparation: indexMetadata is copied canonical index evidence, not a claim extracted from attachment contents. Machine or visual extraction remains unreviewed.
observationContract.sourceReferences: Each observations[].sourceId references an existing source-register entry. Discovery through a registered page may use that page source ID with an explicit note; proposed new sources are not silently treated as registered.

observations.notes: Direct web reader returned HTTP 403. No bypass attempted; no underlying Pililla table, value, roster, or complete archive retrieved.

collectionLimits: Current PSGC and 2020/2024 census tables remain unverified; 17/19 barangay and naming conflict remains unresolved.
Citizen Charter JSON returned an empty table; service procedures, fees, requirements and complete service catalog remain unavailable.
No complete CMCI, municipal finance, procurement, project, school or health register retrieved; no totals or completion metrics inferred.
No official Cavinti polygon or authoritative boundary export obtained. HazardHunterPH expressly disclaims authority of its approximate administrative boundaries.
Municipal channel publication and page reachability are not contact or hotline live validation. No current local safety advisory asserted.

Legislative PDFs sampled only: one current-year appropriation and one current-year barangay procedure document. No complete attachment corpus, executive-order archive or audit report extracted. Native text blank for both; one budget page visually inspected, not independently legally reviewed.
PAGASA advisory attachment text unreadable; no issue/valid time or Cavinti target area verified. Historical TIEZA document cannot establish current tourism access, operation or arrivals.
Search snippets were used as discovery leads only, not promoted to verified findings.
